articles.title: One year after 10/10, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but other altcoins still face risks
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.description: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year later, has crypto learned anything?
articles.description: One year after a flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets, traders have better tools to spot risks. But the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
articles.description: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
articles.description: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

articles.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
articles.description: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

articles.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
articles.description: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
articles.description: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain considers technology that gives paying traders priority
articles.description: Arbitrum recently replaced its Timeboost transaction-ordering system with a new model called Priority Gas Auctions.

articles.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
articles.description: Alex Mashinsky, already serving 12 years for fraud, settled New York’s civil case over claims he misled Celsius customers about the failed crypto lender’s safety.

articles.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
articles.description: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

articles.title: DWF Labs subsidiaries sue BitGo for $141 million over alleged token lock-up breach
articles.description: DWF is seeking $114 million in damages on the basis BitGo’s token sales resulted in direct losses through the fall in tokens' prices.

articles.title: Zcash developers set January target for quantum-resistant payments after ‘bunker mode’ scare
articles.description: The plan concerns public payments, where about seven in 10 ZEC sit. A separate wallet tool would keep balance checks from revealing which addresses belong together.

articles.title: Trump's Iran pledge underpins crypto gains as bitcoin bears face liquidation pressure
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 9, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
articles.description: Bitcoin recovered to around $82,500 after Trump ruled out an Iran strike, but remains about 4% lower on the week, while ether has lost 9%.

articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.description: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links
articles.description: Britain said the crypto platforms and two payment services may have helped Russia evade financial sanctions, with two handling transactions involving the Kremlin-backed A7 network.

articles.title: Dark web drug market operator sentenced to 40 years, forfeits $101 million in bitcoin
articles.description: A man from Virginia, who facilitated millions of drug transactions worth roughly $430 million, agreed to give up $100 million worth of BTC. His partner forfeited nearly 1,600 BTC.

articles.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
articles.description: The bitcoin miner’s transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.

articles.title: Sam Altman-backed bitcoin insurer Meanwhile secures $37.5 million in Bain Capital Crypto-led round
articles.description: Meanwhile has signed 15 brokers serving high-net worth clients across markets iSwitzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips from day's highs, set to close week with a loss
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs lost $244 million on Thursday and the ZEC fund extended a run of October outflows. Bitcoin is back near $82,000 after a $1 billion liquidation.

articles.title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
articles.description: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.

articles.title: Solana is about to halve its block times as final 200-millisecond upgrade nears
articles.description: The network is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.

articles.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
articles.description: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.

articles.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
articles.description: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than bitcoin despite ether’s market value being less than a fifth as large.
